sample_data.reset_instructions: Switch between any of the 25 official fixture cases using the top-bar dropdown, or click 'Generate Sample Data' to reseed realistic synthetic marketing data.

problem_solving_method: The team approached P06 by isolating business logic into a pure, deterministic calculation engine covering edge cases (zero baseline, small numbers <1, negative deltas) protected by automated unit tests, accompanied by an accessible dark-mode UI, interactive comparison charts, and localStorage-persisted executive briefings scoped by dataset.

R1.evidence: src/lib/dataGenerator.ts, public/fixtures.json, src/App.tsx (loads 8 clients × 5-7 measures across 2 months from sample or 25 official fixtures)

R2.evidence: src/components/ClientReportCard.tsx, src/lib/reportEngine.ts:calcChange, src/lib/reportEngine.ts:getTopMovers (MoM net change, direction indicators, top 2 movers by magnitude)

R3.evidence: src/lib/reportEngine.ts:generateSummary, src/components/ClientReportCard.tsx (dynamic natural language executive summary naming exact measures and changes)

R4.evidence: src/components/BatchView.tsx, src/components/AlertConfig.tsx, src/lib/reportEngine.ts:checkAlerts (multi-client batch card grid and configurable alert threshold engine)

team_members.major_contribution: End-to-end architecture, report calculation engine, automated edge-case test suite, UI components, and chart visualization.
Codebase debugging, test case verification, calculation edge-case QA, and live deployment validation.

major_design_decisions: Zero-dependency pure calculation engine (reportEngine.ts) to guarantee deterministic outputs and eliminate side-effects.
Downgraded from Vite 8 to Vite 7.3.6 to strictly eliminate the prohibited MPL-2.0 licensed lightningcss dependency.
Handcrafted SVG/CSS comparative chart systems to avoid bulky chart libraries and ensure 100% license compliance.
Namespaced localStorage persistence (datasetKey::clientId) to eliminate data leakage across test fixtures.
Flattened single-root project structure to enable zero-config static hosting deployment.
known_limitations: Local client data storage relies on browser localStorage; enterprise multi-user cloud synchronization is not implemented.
Print export relies on browser print dialog; standalone server-side PDF generation is a planned enhancement.
